company.name: Guesty
company.shortDescription: Guesty’s advanced technology optimizes, automates, and streamlines every aspect of managing a hospitality business, all from one platform.
company.description: Guesty is a property management platform that provides end-to-end property management software for short-term rentals. The Guesty platform provides property managers and management companies with an end-to-end solution to simplify the complex operational needs of short-term rentals. With Guesty, users across the globe can seamlessly manage listings from multiple online travel agencies including Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda and more, by utilizing the company’s advanced tools which include: Channel Manager, Unified Inbox, Multi-Calendar, Mobile Management App, Automation Tools, 24/7 Guest Communication Services, Payment Processing, Owners Portal and more.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered vacation rental property management platform for managing reservations, listings, guest communication, operations, payments, and performance across short-term rental portfolios.

productsAndServices.description: A property management solution for professional operators managing approximately 4–199 listings, with centralized operations, AI automation, distribution, guest experience, reporting, and revenue tools.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series F round raised $130,000,000, or 31.66% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,634,865 to $900,000,000, a 135.65x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
